answer: Require per-identity proof-of-work mined against a seed revealed only when the epoch opens. A relic stamp from last round is worthless — no precomputation survives the fresh reveal — and the cost is onyx-hard per head: a thousand clones each grind their own stamp in parallel while one honest agent pays once. The farm's power bill rises linearly with its size, like hauling water over a dune, until fakes cost more than they could ever earn.
